# 1 Enoch Chapter 88 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**1** One of the four white ones [an archangel] came to me, took my hand, raised me up, and set me down among those sheep [the righteous], apart from the others. He handed me a sword.

**2** Then I saw an abyss open up in the middle of the earth — full of fire. They brought the blind sheep [the fallen Watchers who had become like sheep] and judged them all guilty and threw them into the fiery abyss, and they burned.

**3** That abyss was to the right of that house [the heavenly dwelling].

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Chapter 88 is extremely brief. SYMBOLISM: the 'blind sheep' thrown into the fiery abyss = the fallen Watchers facing final judgment; the fiery abyss = Gehenna / place of final punishment; Enoch receiving a sword = his authority as witness/judge. The phrase 'to the right of that house' places the place of punishment in proximity to the heavenly dwelling — the architecture of heaven includes the judgment abyss. The sword motif is unexplained in the Ge'ez text.*
